rocky_context.label: Rocky Context
rocky_context.description: Context subsystem built-in impls (ingest / assemble mapper+reducer / system_prompt / system_reminder / compact; 41 impls)

query_truncate.description: Ingest stage: truncate user query (clipped when exceeding queryTruncateChars threshold)

tool_result_truncate.description: Ingest stage: truncate tool_result (clipped when exceeding toolResultTruncateChars threshold)

system_reminder_injector.description: Ingest stage: inject system_reminder (aggregate reminder provider chain output into message stream)

buffer_sink.description: [v0.0.40 D1=B] Forked-scope-only sink: append to ctx.buffer instead of store.appendMessages (disabled in default scope)

store_sink.description: [v0.0.49 D15] Default-scope-only sink: append to store transcript (registered as chain tail; disabled in forked scope, falls back to buffer_sink)

identity.description: System prompt identity fragment (agent name / role / capability boundary; highest-priority tier)

rules.description: System prompt behavioral rules fragment (interaction constraints / safety policy)

tool_guidance.description: System prompt tool usage guidance (when / how to call tools)

skills.description: System prompt enabled skills list (for LLM to choose and invoke)

context_files.description: System prompt context-files fragment (injects references to read files)

memory_user.description: [v0.0.51] System prompt user-level long-term memory fragment (user_memory.md whole-file injection; stable tier; priority 450)

memory_session.description: [v0.0.51] System prompt session-level memory fragment (session_memory.md whole-file injection; context tier; priority 350)

memory_group.description: [v0.0.205] System prompt group-level shared memory fragment (.rocky/memory/ under the squad shared workspace, L0 injection; stable tier; priority 400)

squad_role.description: [v0.0.33.3] Squad role spec fragment (leader/mate/squad_chat.md fixed fragment; empty for subagent/standalone; priority 950 stable; replaces member.systemPrompt as identity body)

team_roster.description: [v0.0.33.2] Squad team roster fragment (invisible to subagents; stable tier; memberIds → name + role + sessionId)

parent_task.description: [v0.0.33.2] Parent task fragment (subagent only; stable tier; spawn input task)

tier_sort.description: System prompt reducer: sort fragments by tier (identity > rules > others)

dedup.description: System prompt reducer: dedupe fragments (last write wins per key)

budget_truncate.description: System prompt reducer: truncate by token budget (budgetFraction / floor / ceiling)

floor.description: Budget floor in tokens (char × ratio estimate)

ceiling.description: Budget ceiling in tokens (char × ratio estimate)

transcript_reader.description: Assemble: read most recent N transcript messages (limit controls count)

limit.description: Read most recent N messages (N = limit)

summary_reader.description: Assemble: read historical compaction summaries (portion beyond transcript window)

candidateLimit.description: Head/tail candidate fetch limit each (anchored at session start / summaryUpTo)

prev_snapshot.description: Assemble: read previous round's context snapshot (for incremental assembly)

system_prompt.description: Assemble: read system prompt (concatenation of mapper + reducer PromptFragments)

buffer_reader.description: [v0.0.40 D1=B] Forked-scope-only source: read ctx.buffer instead of transcript_reader from store (disabled in default scope)

base_builder.description: Assemble reducer: base slicing (head/tail anchored excerpts within token cap)

tokenCap.description: Head/tail token cap each (char×ratio estimate; stop adding when exceeded, min 1 message kept)

side_run_builder.description: Side-run-only assemble reducer: reuse fixed parentSnapshot + in_memory delta (parent full + upsert of new messages past summaryUpTo)

orphan_tool_call.description: Assemble reducer: clean up orphan tool_call (calls without matching tool_result)

bubble_text_before_tool_call.description: Clean view reducer: bubble assistant text blocks before tool_call blocks (tool_use must be immediately followed by tool_result; text in between causes provider 400)

think_remove.description: Assemble reducer: drop reasoning (think) content blocks from all messages

fill_empty_text.description: Assemble reducer: fill empty text content blocks of user/tool(success) with "empty" to prevent LLM 400

empty_message.description: Assemble reducer: clean up empty messages (messages with no content)

role_merge.description: Assemble reducer: merge adjacent same-role messages (consecutive user/assistant merged)

snip_handler.description: Assemble reducer: handle snip markers (placeholder at compaction boundary)

append_passthrough.description: [v0.0.40 D1=B] Forked-scope-only reducer: pass buffer through as-is without rebuild/head-tail/summary (disabled in default scope)

env.description: System reminder: environment info (OS / shell / cwd and other runtime context)

time.description: System reminder: current time (current date for LLM time awareness)

workspace.description: System reminder: workspace state (current workspace / grep context)

tool_error.description: System reminder: tool error hint (guidance when tool invocation fails)

todo.description: System reminder: todo list (todo progress tracking hint)

squad_agents_status.description: [v0.0.273] Squad unified all-member status reminder (dispatches by leader/mate/squad/subagent; lists all members running/idle + presence; SquadChat row gated by enableGroupChat; replaces reachable_agents + squad_team_status)

squad_workspace.description: [v0.0.111] Squad team workspace reminder (leader + mate; injects team drive root <dataDir>/squads/<squadId>; coexists with personal workspace)

squad_task.description: [v0.0.240] Squad task reminder (leader sees all active tasks / mate sees owner=me ∪ blocking-me; task = panorama builtin entity; archived excluded; emitted every round, dedup-reduced)

threshold_should_compact.description: [v0.0.40] Compact predicate: (totalTokens + maxOutputTokens) / tokenLimit > compactRatio (default 0.6) → true; proactive compaction, not wall-bump

compactRatio.description: Usage / tokenLimit ratio above which compaction triggers (proactive, not wall-bump)

reject_should_compact.description: [v0.0.40] Compact predicate dummy: always returns false (never compact). Forked scope explicitly selects via setExclusive to express 'this scope never compacts' for recursion safety, replacing the disable-only impl to avoid zero-active

summary_do_compact.description: [v0.0.40] Compact action: forkedRun(summary, NO_TOOLS, maxIter=1) → extractTag → setSummary (thin shell delegating to context-compact-runner); [v0.0.186] bakes the full summary block (preamble+head+tail) at compact time, assembled messages read it directly with zero computation

tokenCap.description: Baked head/tail token cap each (char×ratio estimate; stop adding when exceeded, min 1 message kept; same default as base_builder tokenCap)

candidateLimit.description: Baked head/tail candidate count cap each (anchored: head from session first message / tail ending at summaryUpTo; same default as summary_reader candidateLimit)

noop_do_compact.description: [v0.0.40] Compact action noop: no-op (no compaction). Forked scope explicitly selects via setExclusive as defense-in-depth (reject_should_compact already gates; structurally unreachable), keeping exclusive EP non-zero-active in forked

memory_skill_consolidation.description: [v0.0.51] Post-compact handler: after compaction, spawn fork-2 consolidation agent (allowed tools=[skill_manage, memory_manage]; fire-and-forget; directly invokes tools to persist memory/skill)

noop_post_compact.description: [v0.0.51] Post-compact handler noop: no-op. After forked scope disables memory_skill_consolidation, this impl is the only active handler for the ordered EP (defense-in-depth against recursive consolidation)

llm_provider.description: LLM auth and model metadata provider (stateless code; carries API Key / base URL / model list)

llm_protocol.description: LLM request/response protocol translator (body shaping + path/contentType; stateless code)

context_ingest_handler.description: Ordered transform chain before ingest persistence (Message[] → Message[]; truncation / reminder injection)

context_assemble_mapper.description: Ordered chain reading assemble data sources (map → deepMerge; transcript/summary/snapshot/prompt)

context_assemble_reducer.description: Ordered chain for incremental assemble assembly (reduce → Message[]; head/tail budget slicing)

context_clean_view_reducer.description: Ordered chain for clean-up view before feeding LLM (reduce → Message[]; runs on deep-clone, original snapshot untouched)

system_prompt_mapper.description: Ordered chain contributing system prompt (map → concat PromptFragment[]; identity/rules/skills/memory etc.)

system_prompt_reducer.description: Ordered chain processing system prompt (reduce → PromptFragment[]; tier sort/dedup/budget truncation)

system_reminder.description: Ordered chain of system reminder providers (provide → concat SystemReminder[]; env/time/workspace/todo etc.)

context_should_compact.description: Compaction trigger predicate (exclusive≤1; usage/tokenLimit>threshold→true; forked scope explicitly selects reject_should_compact returning false to prevent recursive compaction)

context_do_compact.description: Compaction action (exclusive≤1; forkedRun(summary)→setSummary; invoked by tryCompact when shouldCompact returns true)

context_post_compact.description: Ordered handler chain after compaction completes (e.g. memory_skill_consolidation spawns fork-2 agent to consolidate; forked scope skips to prevent recursion)

web_search_provider.description: web_search backend provider (query→structured results; credentials/billing isolated; list — multiple impls coexist, single-point routing by app_config.web_search.type)

see_image_provider.description: see_image image-understanding backend provider (text + local image paths→text understanding; credentials/vender capability isolated; list cardinality; routed precisely via app_config.see_image.type)

session_store.description: Context engine session store (exclusive≤1, session-level message persistence sink; default→durable transcript / forked→in-memory)

channel.description: IM channel access layer (list cardinality; Feishu/future WeChat/DingTalk; message path parallel to web client)

skill_market_provider.description: Skill market source provider (exclusive≤1; search/getDetail/fetchSkillFiles hit the market source API; scope `selected` picks the source, fully swappable)

scope.deleteBody: Delete {{name}}? EP activation records and impl configs under this scope will be cleared (revert to default). This cannot be undone.

ep.deactivateBody: Deactivate {{pointId}}? Independent configuration for this EP under this scope will be cleared (revert to inheriting default). This cannot be undone.

empty.extPoint: No extension points under this group.
